summary: The Seru Administratum is the center of governance and justice in Sanctus Seru, where laws are drafted, enforced, and adjudicated with uncompromising precision.
history: Established after the schism with Katta Castrum to centralize Seru’s doctrine.
The Records Hall stores centuries of edicts, rulings, and citizen registries.
The Judicial Chamber oversees trials and disciplinary hearings.
The Edict Forge produces magical seals used to enforce Seru’s laws.
The High Court serves as the final authority on all matters of order.
